verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs confirm a marketplace search/filter system for GPU type ('filter by GPU type, RAM, CPU...') and datacenter-verified 'Secure Cloud' machines, plus discount mechanisms (reserved, interruptible bidding) that fit the 'cheaper previous-gen' part of the story, but every concrete GPU example in the evidence (search queries, CLI examples) references RTX_4090 rather than H100/H200/B200-class datacenter cards, so current-gen availability is not directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit listing/confirmation of H100/H200/B200 offer types, independent confirmation of top-tier GPU availability, and clarity on how new vs old generations are distinguished in search results.
